purpose: Classify public contracts by whether they actually circulate through the runtime refinery pipeline.
active_contract_rule: A public active contract must have a schema file, a runtime producer or consumer, and a runtime schema-file validation/load path. Contracts that only appear as schema_version strings are declared interfaces, not active pressure-tested pipes.

declared_interface_allowlist.amundsen_category_judgment.v1.schema.jso: Category judgment is produced by runtime reasoning but not yet schema-file validated in the hot path.
declared_interface_allowlist.community_growth_event.v1.schema.json: Community growth records are produced and consumed by vault lineage logic; hot-path schema validation is still pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.decision_timeline_event.v1.schema.json: Decision timeline records are produced and consumed by vault lineage logic; hot-path schema validation is still pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.memory_ticket.v1.schema.json: Memory tickets are admitted by an equivalent strict validator; schema-file validation is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.provenance_ring_node.v1.schema.json: Provenance ring nodes are rendered by the producer and read by retrieval; hot-path schema validation is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.provider_skill_receipt_consumer.v1.schem: Provider skill receipt consumer validates by module-local policy; manifest keeps it non-active until direct schema load is present.
declared_interface_allowlist.provider_source_event.v1.schema.json: Provider source events are produced and consumed by vault lineage logic; hot-path schema validation is still pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.retrieval_candidate.v1.schema.json: Retrieval candidates are produced inside the PTC retrieval orchestrator; direct schema validation is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.retrieval_candidate_set.v1.schema.json: Retrieval candidate sets are produced inside the PTC retrieval orchestrator; direct schema validation is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.semantic_category_path.v1.schema.json: Semantic category paths are produced and consumed by wiki placement; hot-path schema validation is still pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.skill_metadata_reader.v1.schema.json: Skill metadata reader validates by module-local policy; direct schema load is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.subagent_persona_manifest.v1.schema.json: Persona manifests are loaded by reasoning runtime; direct schema load is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.tree_ring_snapshot.v1.schema.json: Tree ring snapshots have module-local guard logic; direct schema validation is pending.
declared_interface_allowlist.wiki_continent_page.v1.schema.json: Wiki continent page contract is emitted into page machine appendix; direct schema validation is pending.

demotion_rule: A root-level public schema with no runtime file hit, no runtime schema_version hit, and no documented compatibility reason must be moved to private quarantine or a legacy/private-only area before production-ready can be claimed.
